findings.title: Page count includes an extra empty page for exact multiples
findings.body: The total page calculation uses floor(user_count / limit) + 1 rather than rounding up. With 50 members and a limit of 50, it reports two pages and enables Next, which requests offset 50 and displays an empty member list. Use a ceiling calculation while retaining the zero-member handling.

findings.title: Public member list is truncated without a way to load remaining members
findings.body: The public group-members route now calls findMembers(), which requests only 50 members by default, but the public members template has no pagination or load-more controls. Non-automatic groups previously returned all members; groups with more than 50 members now have members that cannot be viewed from this page. Add public pagination or otherwise load the remaining results.

findings.title: Existing membership PATCH requests now silently hide groups
findings.body: The resources route still accepts PATCH /admin/groups/:id, but update no longer handles the previously supported changes.add and changes.delete payloads. An existing client sending a membership-only PATCH now receives success without changing membership, and because its request omits visible, this assignment also sets the group's visibility to false. Preserve the PATCH contract or explicitly reject obsolete payloads without modifying the group.
